steps.en: Install the grid (wrappers exist for React/Angular/Vue)
Declare columns: type, editor, and validator per field
steps.zh: 声明列：每列给类型、编辑器与校验器

steps.en: Start on the free evaluation key, swap in the purchased one
steps.zh: 先用免费评估 key，上线换成购买的 key

steps.en: Renders a virtualized grid with spreadsheet keyboard + clipboard
steps.zh: 渲染虚拟化网格，键盘与剪贴板都是电子表格式

steps.en: Evaluates cell formulas through HyperFormula's 400 functions
steps.zh: 公式经 HyperFormula 的 400 个函数求值

steps.en: Runs data validation and conditional formatting as you type
steps.zh: 边输入边跑数据校验与条件格式

value.en: Power users keep their Excel muscle memory inside your product — and you never write the keyboard, clipboard, and recalculation layer yourself
value.zh: 重度用户在你的产品里保留 Excel 肌肉记忆——键盘、剪贴板、重算层都不用你自己写

sources: https://github.com/handsontable/handsontable/blob/master/README.md — `npm install handsontable`; setup sample `{ data: 'company', title: 'Company', width: 100 }` and `new Handsontable(element, {`; `licenseKey: 'non-commercial-and-evaluation'`; Key Features list: 400 built-in formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, virtualization, server-side data (fetched 2026-09-27)
